verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an online government filing service, but the evidence only describes the web-based SOSPortal (filing, search, ordering, My Submissions) and downloadable PDF forms. Nothing mentions a command-line tool. The filing host's robots.txt also bans AI agents by name, which points away from agent-oriented tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
